scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(async fs => { for (const p of ['dist','stage','release','tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) await fs.rm(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm --filter @retailos/web... build && pnpm run build && node scripts/stage-web-runtime.mjs
scripts.desktop:pack:win: node -e "import('node:child_process').then(({spawnSync})=>{const w=process.platform==='win32';const cmd='pnpm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win --dir --config electron-builder.json';const r=spawnSync(w?'cmd.exe':'sh',w?['/d','/s','/c',cmd]:['-c',cmd],{stdio:'inherit',env:{...process.env,RETAILOS_REQUIRE_SIGNED_MANIFEST:'1'}});process.exit(r.status??1);})"
scripts.desktop:dist:win: node -e "import('node:child_process').then(({spawnSync})=>{const w=process.platform==='win32';const cmd='pnpm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.json';const r=spawnSync(w?'cmd.exe':'sh',w?['/d','/s','/c',cmd]:['-c',cmd],{stdio:'inherit',env:{...process.env,RETAILOS_REQUIRE_SIGNED_MANIFEST:'1'}});process.exit(r.status??1);})"
